subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – autoresponder email
body_text:
Hi Rohan,

Thank you for your time on our call. You called because your form was bringing in leads, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them. Here is a quick summary.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, then submitted a test form using your other email address and confirmed that the autoresponder email arrived.

What we covered:
- Emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.

Your next steps:
1. Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings. You mentioned that you planned to do this the morning after our call.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-04

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
